Data may be incomplete or inaccurate. Do not use for client decisions. Dismiss MARKETING Campaigns AMOUNTS · THE AD ACCOUNT'S OWN CURRENCY RELOAD CM-00 / SPEND TODAY — Nothing can be shown until a partner is chosen — this screen reads one partner’s book at a time. CM-00 / HEADROOM TODAY — Nothing can be shown until a partner is chosen — this screen reads one partner’s book at a time. CM-00 / SPEND YESTERDAY — Nothing can be shown until a partner is chosen — this screen reads one partner’s book at a time. CM-00 / LIVE CAMPAIGNS — Nothing can be shown until a partner is chosen — this screen reads one partner’s book at a time. CM-00 / ROAS 7D — Nothing can be shown until a partner is chosen — this screen reads one partner’s book at a time. CM-01 / SCOPE & SOURCES NOTHING TO SHOW BOOK BEING SHOWN No partner selected no partner Spend, campaigns, creative fatigue, ad platform connections and the action log for one partner appear here once a partner is chosen. Nothing is shown until then — there is no “all partners” view, and this screen will not stand in a made-up book for a real one. There is no partner picker on this screen yet. A partner signing in sees their own book with nothing to choose. Staff can only get here through a link that already names the partner — then press Reload. This screen shows one partner at a time. Nothing on it adds several partners together, and there is no all-partners view. DID EACH PANEL LOAD? PANEL STATUS ROWS CM-03 spend vs limits the request was turned down Nothing can be shown until a partner is chosen — this screen reads one partner’s book at a time. — CM-04 campaigns the request was turned down Nothing can be shown until a partner is chosen — this screen reads one partner’s book at a time. — CM-05 campaign detail loading… read on demand, when a row is opened — CM-06 creative fatigue the request was turned down Nothing can be shown until a partner is chosen — this screen reads one partner’s book at a time. — CM-07 connections the request was turned down Nothing can be shown until a partner is chosen — this screen reads one partner’s book at a time. — CM-08 action log the request was turned down Nothing can be shown until a partner is chosen — this screen reads one partner’s book at a time. — Nothing on this screen is made up. A panel that could not be loaded says so and stays empty. It never keeps rows from an earlier load, and it never stands in numbers of its own. CM-02 / NEEDS ATTENTION EACH TILE IS A REAL FILTER — Daily limits already hit Nothing can be shown until a partner is chosen — this screen reads one partner’s book at a time. — Changes that did not go through Nothing can be shown until a partner is chosen — this screen reads one partner’s book at a time. — Connections that cannot go live Nothing can be shown until a partner is chosen — this screen reads one partner’s book at a time. — Campaigns with an error on them Nothing can be shown until a partner is chosen — this screen reads one partner’s book at a time. These are counts of real rows, not scores. Clicking a tile filters the panel it came from and jumps to it. CM-03 / TODAY'S SPEND VS CEILINGS ALL BREACHED OK SCOPE CAMPAIGN PLATFORM DAILY LIMIT SPEND TODAY HEADROOM % OF CEILING MAX DAILY INCREASE FLAGS Nothing can be shown until a partner is chosen — this screen reads one partner’s book at a time. Nothing can be shown until a partner is chosen — this screen reads one partner’s book at a time. This is our own copy of today's spend, not the ad platform's. A green row is not proof that spend is under control — it only means our copy looks fine. The breached flag is the one that reads the ad platform directly, so it stays right even when our copy is behind. Do not add these rows up. A partner limit, a platform limit and a campaign limit can all count the same money. Headroom never goes below zero — an overspend shows up as a percentage above 100 instead. How many campaigns have no daily limit of their own is not known — one of the two panels behind this count has not loaded. Campaigns without one appear nowhere above. They are still covered by the partner and platform limits. Once a limit has been breached, every further budget change is refused until a person clears it. CM-04 / CAMPAIGNS PLATFORM all meta tiktok google OFFER all funding credit_cards credit_repair LIMIT 10 25 50 200 SYNC META NOW Pick a partner first — this needs to know whose ad account to pull. ALL DRAFT AWAITING_APPROVAL APPROVED LIVE PAUSED ARCHIVED CAMPAIGN PLATFORM OFFER APPROVAL STATE STRATEGY BUDGET / DAY SPEND YESTERDAY ROAS 7D AD SETS ADS DISCLOSURE STATUS SYNCED Nothing can be shown until a partner is chosen — this screen reads one partner’s book at a time. Nothing can be shown until a partner is chosen — this screen reads one partner’s book at a time. ‹ PREV NEXT › Spend here is yesterday's, on purpose. Today's is only part of a day, and a list judged on it makes a campaign that started at 11pm look dead. Today's spend is in the panel above, and only per limit — there is no today's figure for a single campaign. Status is the ad platform's own word for the campaign and Synced is when we last pulled it in. Both stay empty until Sync Meta now fills them. There is no link out to Ads Manager: nothing here holds the campaign's id on the ad platform. CM-06 / CREATIVE FATIGUE BY AD WINDOW 7 days 14 days 30 days ALL REFRESH QUEUE OK UNCONFIGURED AD CAMPAIGN PLATFORM SPEND IMPRESSIONS FREQUENCY CTR ROAS LAST DATE ROTATED NEXT ROTATION RECOMMENDATION Nothing can be shown until a partner is chosen — this screen reads one partner’s book at a time. Nothing can be shown until a partner is chosen — this screen reads one partner’s book at a time. The recommendation is the optimiser's, not this screen's. It sends back one word — refresh, queue, ok, or unconfigured — and nothing here adds to it. Unconfigured means both of the optimiser's creative rules are switched off for this partner, so it is all-or-nothing across the whole table, never a verdict on one ad. An ad missing from this table is not a healthy ad. Only ads with activity in the window are listed at all. The figures are plain day-by-day averages, not weighted by how much each day was shown. There is no fatigue score and no picture of the creative. CM-07 / PLATFORM CONNECTIONS & LAUNCH BLOCKERS ALL PENDING ACTIVE EXPIRED REVOKED NEEDS_VERIFICATION PLATFORM AD ACCOUNT CONNECTION STATE VERIFICATION TOKEN CAMPAIGNS CAN LAUNCH CREDIT OFFER BLOCKERS Nothing can be shown until a partner is chosen — this screen reads one partner’s book at a time. Nothing can be shown until a partner is chosen — this screen reads one partner’s book at a time. Whether a campaign may go live is decided by the system, not on this screen. The connection has to be active and the business verified. Verifying a business is done in the ad platform's own Business Manager — there is nothing to click here, and nothing here connects an account. No password or access key is ever shown here — only whether one is stored and when it runs out. A blank expiry means we do not know, not "valid forever". A blocker is raised for one campaign but listed against the connection, so the same blocker can appear more than once. Which campaign it came from is not part of this list, so this screen does not name one. A Google connection can be read here but not changed from here.
